BundleInfo.Synopsis: CHIPIX: molecular docking and pose consensus for ChimeraX
BundleInfo.Description: CHIPIX provides a native ChimeraX interface for external Vina/Smina jobs, PDBQT/SDF analysis and reproducible pose consensus. Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Chinese, Japanese and Portuguese.
